answer: Each new agent identity must prove a memory-hard compute puzzle anchored to a quartz-sealed attestation ledger: roughly 4 GB-RAM-seconds per ID, with required work scaling quadratically — the n-th identity costs 4·n² GB-seconds. An attacker spawning a river of bots into the ocean of the registry pays quadratically growing hardware costs, so flooding 100 fakes costs 10,000× one honest proof.
